## 变更说明 / Summary

<!-- 解决什么问题，修改后的行为是什么，主要如何实现？ / What problem does this solve, what changes for users, and how does it work? -->

## 关联 Issue / Related issues

<!-- 完全解决用 Fixes #123，仅关联用 Refs #123；没有则写“无”。 / Use Fixes #123 for a complete fix or Refs #123 for a related issue; write “None” if there is no issue. -->

## 影响范围 / Scope

<!-- CLI、GUI、Windows、macOS 以及兼容性影响；共同能力说明两端的处理，不受影响或入口专属时注明理由。 / Describe effects on CLI, GUI, Windows, macOS, and compatibility. For shared behavior, explain both entry points; explain any unaffected or entry-specific scope. -->

## 验证情况 / Testing

<!-- 写明实际环境、执行的命令或手工步骤、结果；未运行、跳过或失败的检查及原因也请列出。CLI/GUI 共同行为分别说明验证结果。 / List the actual environment, commands or manual steps, and results. Include skipped, unrun, or failing checks and why. Report CLI and GUI verification separately for shared behavior. -->
